CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 15.02.2023 CRL.M.A. 4000/2023 (Exemption)
1. Exemption is allowed subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application is disposed of.

This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.37/2020 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC at PS Mohan Garden, New Delhi, on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes vide a Settlement Deed dated 09.06.2022, which is on record of this Court.
2. The petitioner Nos.1 - 3 and respondent/complaint are present in the Court, duly identified by the respective counsels and the IO.
Petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 were married on 22.01.2018 and due to mutual disputes and differences, their marriage has now resulted in a divorce granted vide a decree dated 24.11.2022.
No child was born out of the wedlock.
3. Respondent No.2 confirms that there is no further amount or any other articles which have to be received by her as per the settlement.

4. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State Sh Vikas Sharma And Ors vs State Nct Of Delhi And Anr on 15 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129283762/
1 exchequer.
